title: bug: check-architecture run from the candidate's own packages/moe-daemon/dist trusts every module index.ts imports, but requiredChecks scripts protect only the files they name
description:
In Moe's own repo, the CQ-V10 check `node packages/moe-daemon/dist/index.js check-architecture --rules arch.json` runs code built from the candidate. V01 protected drift covers only the listed scripts (checkArchitecture.ts, architectureRules.ts). A candidate can still change the verdict with no protected-check-changed token by editing context/repositorySource.ts, util/cachedPlanPaths.ts, util/logger.ts, or any other module dist/index.js loads, for example by serving '' content or by overriding stdout/exitCode.
Fix (at activation, V12): run the check from a runner-provisioned trusted install built at the base revision, or protect the import closure. This is not exploitable today, because nothing dispatches the check and verified-local is off.
definitionOfDone: A candidate that edits a non-listed module the checker imports cannot turn a failing architecture check into a delivered pass.
Legacy/observe behavior unchanged; tests pin the refusal.
